name: workspace-os
description: Personal and Work profiles for Claude Code: each session uses its saved profile boundary, consequential actions ask first, taste stays profile-local and approval-gated, and on-demand skills help Claude learn from source-cited videos and work in tutor, build, do, or review modes.

personalRoots.title: Personal folders
personalRoots.description: Folders that belong to the Personal profile, separated by ;. Work sessions can't touch them. Example: C:\Users\me\Code\personal

workRoots.title: Work folders
workRoots.description: Folders that belong to the Work profile, separated by ;. Personal sessions, and sessions with no profile, can't touch them.

personalVault.title: Personal vault
personalVault.description: The Personal notes vault folder. Treated as a Personal folder.

workVault.title: Work vault
workVault.description: The Work notes vault folder. Treated as a Work folder.
